# DevFest Milano 2026

> DevFest Milano 2026 is a one-day Google Developer community conference in
> Milan, Italy, co-organized by GDG Cloud Milano and GDG Milano. Talks,
> workshops and networking across cloud, AI, mobile, web and more.

- Date: 10 October 2026, 09:00–19:00 (Europe/Rome, CEST)
- Venue: Randstad Box, Via San Vigilio 5, 20142 Milano (Famagosta, M2)
- Organizers: [GDG Cloud Milano](https://gdg.community.dev/gdg-cloud-milano/)
  and [GDG Milano](https://gdg.community.dev/gdg-milano/)
- Languages: talks in Italian and English
- Tickets: community event, symbolic price — see the [venue page](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/venue)
  and register via [GDG Community](https://gdg.community.dev)
- Call for Speakers: submit via [Sessionize](https://sessionize.com/devfest-milano-2026)
- [Code of Conduct](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/code-of-conduct)
- Last edition (2025): ~300 attendees, 20+ speakers, 20+ sessions, 3 tracks

- [Team](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/team) — organizing team

- [Venue](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/venue) — location and directions
- [FAQ](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/faq) — common questions
- [Call for Speakers](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/it/cfp)

English versions of every page are available under the `/en/` prefix
(e.g. [https://2026.devfestmilano.it/en/agenda](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/en/agenda)).
Machine-readable data: [sitemap.xml](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/sitemap.xml),
[robots.txt](https://2026.devfestmilano.it/robots.txt), and JSON-LD (Event,
FAQPage, Person, BreadcrumbList) embedded in each page's `<head>`.
